title: ServerWork
description: Branch of Framework that brings essential features  and performance for any multiplayer server. Built as a framework to be added to, or use as-is
body:
**Makes the server work**
## Vanilla-like
This pack includes no feature adding mods, only performance and server functions. Gameplay with this pack will be exactly the same as vanilla for normal players, with expanded access for admins to moderate and manage the world.

## Plug-n-play
The goal of this modpack is to be useable by anyone, regardless of their experience and knowledge. Load up a fabric server with this pack and press start, you should be good to go. Players can play with any client that would work on vanilla.

## Expansibility
The majority of the mods in this pack should be compatible with other mods, though it is targetting a mostly vanilla experience. 


_Fun fact: The icon for this pack is Framework's, but run through a swirl filter 100 times._
